description:
Need to share an ID, pay stub, or passport? Mask only what you choose. Review every page and check the exported copy before sharing. OCR runs on your device; you stay in control.

PROTECT WHAT YOU SHARE
Prepare identity documents, contracts, forms, or bank statements for a specific request. Cover ID numbers, addresses, signatures, phone numbers, email addresses, IBANs, account details, and other personal information. Keep required details visible and add a watermark to state the purpose of the redaction.

REVIEW ON YOUR DEVICE
• Use the built-in document scanner or import from Camera, Photos, and Files.
• On-device OCR suggests details that may be sensitive and can work without an internet connection.
• Review every suggested redaction and adjust each mask yourself. You decide what remains visible.
• Prepare multi-page PDFs, images, contracts, pay stubs, forms, and travel documents.
• Optional direct import from Google Drive and Dropbox.

CHECK THE EXPORTED COPY
• Export a flattened, rasterized PDF or image.
• Check the export for hidden text and recoverable layers.
• Remove common GPS, camera and timestamp metadata from supported exports.
• Share the protected copy, not the original.
Checks help you review an export, but cannot confirm that you selected every sensitive area. Review every page and the recipient before sharing.

PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY
• Store documents in an encrypted local library.
• Protect the local Vault with Face ID or PIN and AES-GCM encryption. Vault documents stay on your device.
• Core protection works without an account.
• Optional MaskID Pro iCloud sync stores complete restorable packages for documents outside the Vault in your private CloudKit database.

FREE AND PRO
MaskID Free includes manual masks, on-device OCR suggestions, protected export and the local Vault. Free supports up to 10 documents processed cumulatively. MaskID Pro adds unlimited processing, batch tools, additional mask styles, image controls, purpose workflows and optional cloud features.

promotionalText: Hide only what is not needed. Review every page and check the exported copy on your device before sharing.
whatsNew: Try the three-step review flow without a camera prompt before you choose Scan. Home puts document protection first, PIN setup stays optional, and Library adds native search. On-device face suggestions preserve page orientation and remain reviewable before export. Security labels keep their meaning across themes.
